title: [ORION-QG QG-30] Exact 45-bin bulk coarse-graining and bulk/defect scale separation
body:
Parent programme: #740.
Direct parents: QG-27 #886 / PR #887 exact four-form bulk-density theorem; QG-28 #888 / PR #889 exact 715 local-Clifford orbit-count sufficient statistic.
Related parent: QG-29 #890 / PR #891 finite-size defect-saturation lane.
Method donors: renormalization/coarse-graining, sufficient statistics, invariant theory, universality classes, bulk-versus-defect decomposition.

## Status

**PROSPECTIVE EXACT BULK COARSE-GRAINING THEOREM — freeze before execution.**

QG-28 reduces the exact finite-size target-column histogram from 4096 raw Pauli types to 715 safe local-Clifford orbits. QG-27 shows that the thermodynamic/asymptotic cost density depends only on four distinct spectator bulk baseline forms `b_0,b_1,b_2,b_3`.

For each of the 715 local-Clifford column orbits o define its **bulk signature**

`s(o)=(b_0(o),b_1(o),b_2(o),b_3(o)) in {0,...,6}^4`.

Complete enumeration of the QG-28 canonical orbit representatives yields a frozen target of exactly **45 distinct bulk signatures**.

## Q1 — exact 45-signature census

Rebuild the 715 QG-28 orbits and four QG-27/QG-28 quotient baseline vectors independently. Group the 715 orbits by the ordered four-tuple `s(o)`.

Frozen expected count: **45** distinct signatures.

Serialize the complete 45-signature table with:
- signature tuple;
- number of local-Clifford orbits in the signature;
- total number of original 4096 raw column types represented by those orbits;
- lexicographically first orbit representative;
- SHA256 of the member-orbit representative list.

Required totals: orbit multiplicities sum to 715 and raw-type multiplicities sum to 4096.

No post-outcome merging of signatures in V1.

## Q2 — exact bulk sufficient statistic

For an n-qubit target instance let `H_s` be the total number of physical columns whose local-Clifford orbit has bulk signature s. The 45-vector H is obtained by summing the 715 orbit counts within each signature class.

For every bulk form r,

`B_r(N)=sum_s H_s * s_r`.

Therefore QG-27's exact asymptotic density

`e(p)=min_r beta_r(p)`

and every pure-scaling-ray bulk slope `B_min(h)` depend only on the 45 signature counts, not on the full 715-orbit histogram.

Thus 45 bins are an exact sufficient statistic for the **bulk/asymptotic** TARE geometry.

## Q3 — mandatory finite-size information barrier

QG-30 must **not** claim that 45 bins suffice for the full finite-n exact optimizer or defect potentials.

QG-28/QG-26 active-template corrections depend on exact local target/auxiliary structure, and different local-Clifford orbits can share the same four bulk coefficients while admitting different defect templates.

V1 must actively search for a frozen pair of QG-28 orbit representatives with the same bulk signature but different one-active template correction profiles over the 48 feasible one-column shared-label auxiliary rows. If found, serialize it as an explicit information-loss witness showing:

`BULK_SIGNATURE_SUFFICIENT_FOR_FULL_DEFECT = false`.

If no such pair is found in the complete 715-orbit one-active profile census, report that as a positive surprise and register a successor; do not silently promote full sufficiency in V1.

## Q4 — complete one-active defect-profile census

For each of the 715 orbit representatives, compute an exact one-active **defect profile** under the frozen QG-26/QG-28 control language:
- all 48 feasible shared-label frame/Tag rows;
- all 8 target-permutation tuples;
- canonical central tuple `(0,0,0)`;
- store the sorted multiset (or canonical vector) of `K = structural + F3_aux - spectator_baseline` values.

Group by the 45 bulk signatures and count how many distinct defect profiles occur inside each signature.

This measures exact bulk-to-defect information loss without claiming the one-active profile is a complete finite-size defect invariant.

## Q5 — renormalization-style scale separation

A positive QG-30 result may state:
- 4096 raw types -> 715 exact finite-size local-Clifford orbits -> 45 exact bulk signatures;
- the 45-bin map preserves all extensive/asymptotic bulk costs exactly;
- the 715-bin level retains strictly more finite-defect information if Q3 finds a witness;
- QG-29's bounded O(1) defect term is the information-bearing correction discarded by the 45-bin coarse-graining.

This is an exact compiler-specific **bulk/defect scale separation**, not a physical renormalization-group flow or universality claim.

## Q6 — asymptotic phase geometry on 45 counts

Re-express the four QG-27 bulk forms directly as coefficient rows in `Z^45`. Serialize all six pairwise tie coefficient vectors and their support sizes in signature space.

The normalized 45-frequency simplex has exact asymptotic compiler cells under the lower envelope of these four linear forms.

No finite-n global phase boundary authority.

## Independent generic ORION

Generic ORION must independently rebuild F2^2, the 715 local-Clifford orbits, the four baseline forms, the 45 signature census, and the complete one-active defect-profile grouping. It may bind QG-28/QG-27 parent hashes only after its local construction is sealed.

## Native ORION-Q

May authorize:
- `BULK_SIGNATURE_COUNT_45`
- `BULK_45_HISTOGRAM_SUFFICIENT_FOR_ASYMPTOTIC_DENSITY`
- `ASYMPTOTIC_PHASE_GEOMETRY_DESCENDS_TO_45_COUNTS`
- `BULK_DEFECT_SCALE_SEPARATION` only if Q3 produces explicit information-loss evidence.

Mandatory false:
- `BULK_SIGNATURE_SUFFICIENT_FOR_FULL_DEFECT`
- `FULL_FINITE_N_OPTIMUM_FROM_45_COUNTS`
- `PHYSICAL_RENORMALIZATION_GROUP`
- `FINITE_N_GLOBAL_PHASE_BOUNDARY`
- chain/B'' completeness and novelty/R6/physical-advantage authority.

## Intended strong terminal

`QG30_TARE_BULK_GEOMETRY_COMPRESSES_EXACTLY_TO_45_SIGNATURE_COUNTS__DEFECT_INFORMATION_REMAINS`

Honest alternatives:
- `QG30_SIGNATURE_COUNT_MISMATCH`
- `QG30_BULK_BASELINE_NOT_CONSTANT_ON_SIGNATURE`
- `QG30_NO_ONE_ACTIVE_DEFECT_INFORMATION_LOSS_FOUND__SUCCESSOR_REQUIRED`
- `QG30_QG28_PARENT_BINDING_GAP`
- `QG30_GENERIC_NATIVE_DISAGREEMENT`
- `QG30_CANNOT_CHECK`

## Donor subtraction

Coarse-graining, sufficient statistics, invariant partitions and bulk/defect decompositions are established donor ideas. Candidate contribution is only the exact TARE-specific 715→45 bulk compression and the demonstrated separation between extensive bulk information and bounded compiler-defect information.
